## Proposed skill name

`<kebab-case-slug>` — e.g. `kubernetes-security`, `mariadb-hardening`

## Category

Where would it fit in the README structure?

- [ ] AI & LLM security
- [ ] Web application security
- [ ] Server & infrastructure
- [ ] Identity & access
- [ ] Supply chain & CI/CD
- [ ] Compliance (EU / DACH or other)
- [ ] Detection & monitoring
- [ ] Incident response
- [ ] Mobile security
- [ ] Email security
- [ ] Other (specify):

## When to invoke

Bullet list of concrete situations where this skill would trigger / be useful. Aim for 3–6 items.

- ...
- ...

## What it covers

A paragraph describing the substance. Two or three key patterns, what is unique about this area, what existing skills it would cross-link to.

## Why it is needed

Is there a gap in the current repo? Is there a recent incident pattern, advisory, or technology shift that justifies it?

## Who would write it

Are you proposing to write this yourself? If so, mention your experience with the topic (e.g. "I run Kubernetes in production for X" or "I just did an audit on Y"). If not, that is fine — flag it as "wanted, looking for author".

- [ ] I will write it
- [ ] Looking for an author
